categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and modifies P2PConnection message parsing logic in the Python functional test framework.
categories.rationale: Fixes premature disconnections in the test framework's P2PConnection when socket data is delivered in small chunks. As noted by the author, premature disconnects before a full 24-byte header prevent bitcoind from attempting v1 reconnects, which can cause p2p_v2_encrypted.py to time out.
